summary: The exact-count repeat(n, parser) implementation, repeat_n_, accepted successful parses that consumed no input and accumulated n outputs at the same position. The fix compares eof_offset before and after each successful parse, triggering an assertion panic in debug builds or an assertion error in release builds when no progress occurs. A verbatim reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision. The fix adds no tests; existing empty-parser tests exercise unbounded repetition, while exact-count tests use consuming parsers or zero repetitions. Leave this candidate blocked pending a suitable upstream test; no tests were run.
